common_profile: Fund all submitted senders; one strict native-blob post plus ordered sources; refund one actual external user transaction to the operator treasury, using final-transaction default only when execution dependencies permit. Every receiving builder must independently cover the whole required net receipt.
common_profile_status: Documentation candidate only; not universal live compatibility, efficient pooled fee allocation, or guaranteed atomic settlement.

other_routes.mev_share: Generic nesting/refunds exist, Flashbots public RPC documents one backrun; prior public Titan/Quasar method probes returned -32601. This does not qualify private routes.
other_routes.overlap: No established joint inclusion and refund contract for independently submitted bundles sharing a post. Allowing duplicate post omission does not guarantee all payer bundles execute.
other_routes.self_funded_anchor: Refunding operator-funded tips is an expense rebate, not external fee revenue.
other_routes.provider_extension: Multiple external source hashes and one combined refund is a proposed integration target where currently limited; no provider acceptance or deployed change is asserted.
